standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of an invertible module as one whose tensor product functor is an equivalence, and the existence of an inverse module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The definition under study in the author's section on invertible modules, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Formulates the two equivalent conditions of the statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms with the homomorphisms of the stalks for a finitely presented module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4341-4345) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the verification of the evaluation map to a statement about the stalks.

core_obligations: Equivalence: assuming invertibility the tensor product functor is essentially surjective, which produces the inverse module, and conversely an inverse module makes the tensor product functor an equivalence (proof lines 4299-4304)

Local splitting: from the trivialising isomorphism the proof extracts finitely many local sections whose pairing of tensors maps to one and exhibits an automorphism of the module which factors through a finite free module, so the module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module (proof lines 4306-4329)

The dual: it remains to show that the evaluation map from the tensor product of the module with its sheaf of homomorphisms into the structure sheaf is an isomorphism, which may be checked on stalks because the module is now known to be finitely presented (proof lines 4331-4345)
Stalk computation: on stalks the statement reduces to the corresponding algebraic statement for an invertible module over a ring (proof lines 4346-4356)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：张量函子本质满，取 N 使 L ⊗ N ≅ O_X；(2)⇒(1) 则 N 给出拟逆。再由 ψ: L ⊗ N ≅ O_X 局部取 ∑ s_i ⊗ t_i ↦ 1，得 L|_U 的自同构 s ↦ ∑ψ(s ⊗ t_i)s_i 通过 O_U^{⊕n} 分解，故 L|_U 是有限自由模的直和项。
最后证赋值映射 L ⊗ Hom(L, O_X) → O_X 是同构：L 此时有限表现，可用 lemma-stalk-internal-hom 化归到茎上，再由茎上 L_x ⊗ N_x = O_{X,x} 与跨章的代数事实。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises invertible modules as those admitting an inverse module, and in that case identifies the inverse with the sheaf of homomorphisms into the structure sheaf and records that the module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module (author lemma at source lines 4283-4296, label lemma-invertible). The proof (source lines 4298-4357) turns the equivalence into a statement about the tensor product functor, extracts a local splitting from the trivialising isomorphism through an automorphism factoring over a finite free module, and finally verifies the evaluation map on stalks, where the algebraic statement applies (proof lines 4306-4356). The local splitting and the stalk computation are the content. H3.
